Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 11. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name Balmer Lawrie and Co Ltd Account No. 32205133995 IFSC Code SCBL0036002 Bank Name Standard Chartered Bank Branch address Mani Boutique, 4A Nandalal Basu Sarani (Little Russel Street), Kolkata – 700071 .
